fetch.partial: Updated, but some entries could not be read
fetch.emptyList: The subscription returned an empty list of profiles

body.html: A web page came instead of the key list: the subscription may have expired or access may be blocked
body.json: The response is JSON without supported keys
body.base64: The response is base64 data without supported keys
body.uris: The response holds no supported key
body.other: The subscription server's response could not be read

fetch.http: The subscription server answered with HTTP error {{code}}

net.dns: The subscription server's address could not be found (DNS)
net.connect: Could not connect to the subscription server
net.tls: A secure connection to the subscription server could not be established
net.proxy: The local proxy does not answer
net.reset: The connection to the subscription server was interrupted

fetch.timeout: The subscription server did not answer in time
fetch.invalidUrl: This is not a subscription address: an http:// or https:// link is needed

refresh.groupChanged: The subscription was changed or deleted during the refresh
refresh.unusableUrl: The subscription has no usable address: add it again
